title: NeuroDETR: Multiscale Discrete Spatiotemporal Tokenization for Asynchronous EEG Event Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.20349v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Asynchronous EEG event detection supports practical brain-computer interfaces by identifying event classes and temporal boundaries directly from continuous recordings without predefined event boundaries at inference time. The primary challenge lies in extracting event-related patterns embedded in ongoing background activity. To address this, we propose \textbf{NeuroDETR}, a discrete spatiotemporal multiscale framework that combines structured tokenization with event-aware feature refinement. Multiscale temporal codebooks capture brief responses and sustained dynamics, while Spatial-Pyramid VQ hierarchically encodes spatial structure across EEG channels. These complementary representations form a compact event memory for jointly classifying events and estimating their onsets and offsets. translated_title: NeuroDETR：面向异步脑电（EEG）事件检测的多尺度离散时空标记化
translated_abstract: 异步脑电事件检测通过直接从连续记录中识别事件类别及其时间边界来支持实用的脑机接口应用，而无需在推理时预先定义事件边界。其主要挑战在于从持续进行的背景活动中提取与事件相关的模式。为解决这一问题，我们提出了NeuroDETR，一个将结构化标记化与事件感知特征细化相结合的离散时空多尺度框架。多尺度时间码本用于捕获短暂响应和持续动态，而空间金字塔VQ（Spatial-Pyramid VQ）则分层地编码EEG通道间的空间结构。这些互补的表示构成了一个紧凑的事件记忆库，用于联合分类事件并估计其起始和结束时间。在标记化之前，我们应用FOCAL——一个事件感知的稀疏注意力模块，它利用预测的事件存在性来引导时间特征细化……
tldr: NeuroDETR提出了一种融合多尺度时间码本、空间金字塔VQ和事件感知稀疏注意力模块FOCAL的离散时空多尺度框架，能够在无需预定义事件边界的情况下，从连续EEG记录中联合检测事件类别及其起止时间。
en_tdlr: NeuroDETR is a discrete spatiotemporal multiscale framework that combines multiscale temporal codebooks, Spatial-Pyramid VQ, and an event-aware sparse attention module (FOCAL) to jointly classify EEG events and estimate their onsets and offsets from continuous recordings without predefined event boundaries.
